final: SELECT b.event_status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS status_avg_budgeted_minus_spent, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) - (SELECT AVG(status_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS status_avg FROM budget GROUP BY event_status)) AS difference_from_overall_avg FROM budget AS b GROUP BY b.event_status HAVING (SELECT AVG(status_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS status_avg FROM budget GROUP BY event_status)) IS NOT NULL
